infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: CRAVE uses your location to show restaurants that can serve you nearby. You can use CRAVE without sharing location by choosing a suburb.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: CRAVE uses the camera so you can record food videos to share.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: CRAVE uses the microphone to record audio with your food videos.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: CRAVE lets you choose food videos and photos from your library to upload.
